AccuracyDemand.description:
Consumed accuracy of one operation. Its product identity is declared by the math owner
and includes the actual output/action, derivative order/source and coordinate meaning.

allowance.description: Finite nonnegative error allowance; zero demands exact evidence.

class.description: Evidence class required by this operation, separate from original physical tolerances.

normalization.description: Coordinate/error normalization in which the allowance is stated.

product.description: Exact operation/product demanded; no capability table is inferred from this hash.

BranchPolicy.description: Root-selection meaning retained by every proposal and correction.

connected.description: Required precisely for the connected policy.

kind.description: Any qualified root, or continuation on a declared connected sheet.

ConnectedPath.description:
Explicit originating path/sheet and the consumed transport/orientation witnesses.
Supplying identities is not proof: the responsible path owner validates the products.

sheet.description: Selected root sheet; a shared regime label alone is insufficient.

transport.description: Transport evidence between the source and target bindings.

Mechanism.description:
One operation description. Applicability, supplied derivatives and method mathematics
remain with its support producers; this declaration owns bounded composition only.

kind.description: Declared numerical operation, from the shared registry vocabulary.

limits.description: Additional local finite allowances under the enclosing task scope.

operation.description: Exact prerequisites and bounded production obligations of this operation only.

position.description: Preparation, execution or a later recovery rung.

profile.description: Explicit effective native profile; absent lets the contextual route resolve the base.

required.description: Failure of required admission ends this task; optional absence can preserve its base.

starts.description: Permitted proposal origins for this mechanism; entry rules still take precedence.

support.description: Exact producer-owned support contracts required by this operation.

transitions.description: Declared transitions. Terminal stops remain obligatory, regardless of numerical history.

NumericalStrategy.description:
Immutable ordered declaration. Ordering affects composition and identity; no backend
ranking or universal direct-first escalation is implied. With no request, the runtime
constructs direct(start, limits) from its existing admitted controls and enclosing scope.

limits.description: Existing admitted task/occurrence finite limits, never refreshed at a new rung.

mechanisms.description: Ordered composition. At least one execution operation is required.

start.description: Entry intent and explicit later-start permissions.

OperationContract.description:
Input requirements are consumed before use; output contracts grant bounded production,
never possession of the future output's certificate.

inputs.description: Actual prerequisites consumed by this particular operation.

outputs.description: Products this operation may attempt to refine under the supplied demands.

ProductDemand.description: The consumer's exact dependency contract. No field is inferred from capabilities.

accuracy.description: Required product/error normalization and evidence class.

source.description: The immutable dependencies and actual point the consumer requires.

ProductionDemand.description: A producer's finite output obligation, before the output point or receipt exists.

allowance.description: Finite error allowance in the source's declared normalization.

branch.description: Original branch permission required of the output.

class.description: Required evidence class; support never supplies the future receipt.

derivative_order.description: The action order this producer must actually establish.

source.description: Frozen producer dependencies. An absent point names a point selected during execution.

ProfileRef.description: Effective admitted native settings, interpreted by their existing native owner.

backend.description: Explicit implementation; changing it requires another declared reference.

key.description: Complete effective method/settings identity, including set versus unset options.

SemanticProductKey.description:
Actual consumed dependencies of a semantic product. Omitted fields were not consumed;
producer ownership determines compatibility, including lawful transport between values.

branch.description: Actual selected sheet/branch evidence, when consumed.

point.description: Point actually consumed, distinct from a future proposal's target.

StartRules.description: Entry intent and separately declared permissions for later starts in this task.

policy.description: Existing request's entry policy; a strategy cannot reinterpret its precedence.

recovery.description:
Permitted replacement origins. A fresh task-produced proposal may precede
a non-explicit entry; inherited products still obey the entry policy.

WorkLimits.description:
Additional finite work allowances. None imposes no additional counter cap under the
enclosing finite ExecutionScope; it never denotes an observed zero or a new deadline.
Every supplied counter is finite; Some(0) expressly prohibits that operation.

attempts.description: Maximum executions, including the first attempt. A task requires at least one.

evaluations.description: Evaluations admitted by the charging owner, including rejected trials.

factorizations.description: Numerical factor constructions, distinct from structural analysis/setup reuse.

iterations.description: Native/library iterations, where the operation exposes them.

proof_steps.description: Verification/proof operations accounted by their owning verifier.

description: Current strategy wire document. Historical bodies are not silently reinterpreted.

version.description: Exact current document version, checked before decoding its body.
